description:
SHIPPED s470bn (Opus, 2026-09-05), commit `3f24edc`.  Closes the perf half of
#1153.

THE RULED PREMISE IS FALSE, and the probe is the finding.  s470 ruled that a
literal delta suffices because "a raw-numeric-verdict slot cannot hold a blessed
box".  It can, by two routes, both probed:
  * a raw compound write with a NON-literal delta â `my $s = 0; $s += $obj`
    emits `(p-incf-raw $s $o)`, perl's `+` handler returns an OBJECT and the raw
    slot holds it; a later `$s *= 3` then has a literal delta and a BLESSED
    current value;
  * a B-regime write â `%pcl-to-number-strict` DECLINES the freeze and stores
    `(p-box-init V)`, i.e. a box, exactly when the value is overload-capable.

SO THE LICENCE IS ABOUT THE SLOT.  VarAnnotator's new `numonly`: `unboxable`,
NOT the B regime, every write family `num`, and every write stores a
compile-time NUMBER (a plain `=` with a literal RHS, a numeric compound op with
a literal delta, or a root ++/--).  NOT "num-FAMILY": `$x = $a + $obj` is
num-family and yields an object.  `_tw_num_literal` is its own predicate beside
`_tw_shape_ok` because the questions differ (raw-STORABLE vs a NUMBER).

EMISSION: a trailing `:numeric` on the raw twin, read by
%define-compound-pair and threaded into %compound-arith-form by the four
numeric templates (`+= -= *= %=`).  Kind-A name `numeric-slot`.

=== DONE (s470bn) ===
WHAT IT BUYS IS THE BRANCH, NOT THE TESTS â each HALF of the guard alone costs
as much as the whole (box-test-only 0.028, flag-read-only 0.030, guard 0.029 s
on the 4e6 loop), because with the branch gone SBCL compiles the body as
straight-line arithmetic.  Ceiling -62.5 %; SHIPPED -59.2 % (0.0331 -> 0.0135 s,
control +0.2 %) â #1153's acceptance was ~0.015 s.  Bench-row A/B under
PCL_OPT=-numeric-slot: mulmod -62.0 %, cfor -21.6 %, collatz -1.8 %;
`intloop+=`, `strcat` and an overloaded boxed `+=` EMISSION-IDENTICAL (the
licence declines a non-literal delta, a string family and a boxed slot) = the
"`.=` and boxed `+=` unmoved" half of the acceptance.  Gate 205/6965 after
repairing THREE stale shape guards (parser2-01.t 31+33, statements-01.t 7).
16 guard rows incl. six negatives.
subject: numeric-slot: a raw slot that can only hold a NUMBER drops the compound-assign overload guard (#1153 -62 %) - and #1153\x27s ruled premise CORRECTED
